subject: Commercial authority ask: conditional rebate & packaging proposal for Acme Therapeutics
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Commercial authority ask: conditional rebate & packaging proposal for Acme Therapeutics

Folks — forwarding the request from Acme (Sarah) below. TL;DR: they want a blended 25% effective discount across a 12‑month committed usage contract in exchange for a two‑year minimum and a provision for private VPC deployment. They also asked for a starter credit and an onboarding surcharge waiver.

Why this needs traction: the deal is attractive strategically (major life‑sciences customer, referenceable) but the blended unit economics push margin below our standard guardrails for Dedicated/Dual deployment. They asked for VP/CFO signoff for anything beyond standard packaging.

Requesting: 1) quick P&L impact review, 2) recommended escalation memo we can send to VP/CFO with a clear ask and recommended counter (if any), and 3) a short note on precedent / risk (data residency, support SLA uplift).

Attachments: ACME_committed_pricing_model.xlsx (customer‑facing numbers they proposed).

Timing: Sarah expects a commercial response by EOD Tuesday (11/24). I want to get an internal recommendation by COB Monday so we can iterate.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial authority ask: conditional rebate & packaging proposal for Acme Therapeutics

Kim — thanks, this is clear. I ran a first‑pass on the customer numbers and attached a short model (financial_impact_q4_v2.xlsx) with two scenarios: the customer's ask (25% blended) and a counter at 18% blended with a graduated step‑up tied to usage.

Notes:
- The 25% blended reduces gross margin below our 30% threshold for Dedicated+Private deployment given the expected token mix (embeddings + high‑latency inference).
- We can keep ASPs higher by requiring a minimum committed GPU pool and excluding private VPC premium from the discount.
- If they sign a 24‑month term instead of 12, we can consider an additional one‑time onboarding credit rather than a recurring discount.

I recommend: prepare a concise memo to VP/CFO asking for an exception to allow a 20% blended (with the VPC premium carveout) contingent on a 24‑month term and a one‑time onboarding credit not to exceed $50k. I'll annotate the model with sensitivity ranges this afternoon.

— Jonas
(attachment: financial_impact_q4_v2.xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Draft memo for VP/CFO: ACME conditional rebate authorization (for review)

Kim / Jonas — attached is a draft briefing (KM-briefing_ACME_rebate_proposal.docx). Key points summarized here for quick review:

1) Commercial ask: 25% blended discount across committed monthly usage for 12 months + VPC private deployment + onboarding credit request (~$60k).
2) Recommendation: grant a commercial exception limited to a 20% effective blended discount, conditioned on a 24‑month contract, carveout of private VPC tooling (no discount on VPC premium and professional services), and a one‑time onboarding credit capped at $50k.
3) Financial impact: revenue delta vs. standard pricing = -$1.8M over first year under customer's ask; recommended path reduces the delta to -$0.9M while preserving higher lifecycle ARR upside via a 24‑month commitment.
4) Risks / precedent: this will set a concession precedent for other enterprise life‑sciences deals; propose a 3‑month review clause and an internal playbook addendum.

Comment requests: please flag any factual/data issues and any alternative ask to put in the memo before I route to VP/CFO. I can convert the attachment to a one‑page executive memo if you prefer.

Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
(attachment: KM-briefing_ACME_rebate_proposal.docx)

Subject: Fwd: Commercial authority ask: conditional rebate & packaging proposal for Acme Therapeutics — request for VP/CFO signoff

Hi — forwarding for signoff. Short summary below and attached one‑page memo.

Summary: Acme Therapeutics (Sarah Klein) requests a 25% blended discount on committed usage (12 months), plus private VPC deployment and a ~$60k onboarding credit. We are asking for an exception to grant a 20% blended discount only if they move to a 24‑month term, agree that the VPC premium and professional services are excluded from the discount, and accept a one‑time onboarding credit capped at $50k. Financial impact under the recommended path is approximately -$0.9M in first‑year revenue vs. list.

Attachments: KM-briefing_ACME_rebate_proposal.docx; financial_impact_q4_v2.xlsx

Ask: please confirm either: Approve the recommended exception as‑is / Approve with edits (please specify) / Deny and we'll revert to standard cadence. If helpful I can set a 15‑minute sync with Sarah and VP/CFO today.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
